en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.496 - Yunus ibn Ya'qub asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) about performing the funeral prayer without being in a state of ritual ablution (wudu).

Imam (as) replied: "Yes, it is permissible, for it is comprised of takbir (saying 'Allahu Akbar'), tasbih (glorification of Allah (swt)), tahmid (praise of Allah (swt)), and tahlil (declaration of 'La ilaha illa Allah (swt)'), just as you say them in your home."
